known_secrets.text: During a deep irrigation repair, I found stonework that does not match any known terrace design.
It was beneath older layers of irrigation channels.
The structure looked intentional, not natural.
I did not report it immediately.
When I later checked, part of it had been covered by sediment again.
I suspect the mountain shifts more than people admit.
Mara once told me she thinks food stores sometimes 'go missing faster than expected.'
I think she is right, but I have no proof.
